Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter - A.S. No. 2764/2022

Dear Ms. Mishra,

Thank you for meeting us on 08/11/2022 about your dispute with Sunrise Marine Ltd. As we understand it, the owners dispute the value of the salvage.

Our advice is to claim a salvage award based on the value of the property saved. Please collect the valuation of the vessel and cargo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 43,51,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
